units.rawText: Somewhere in Magrasea.
units.displayText: Somewhere in Magrasea.

spans.text: Somewhere in Magrasea.

units.rawText: The pitch-black goat leaps here; the signal comes from nowhere, and heads to nowhere.
units.displayText: The pitch-black goat leaps here; the signal comes from nowhere, and heads to nowhere.

spans.text: The pitch-black goat leaps here; the signal comes from nowhere, and heads to nowhere.

units.rawText: So what's the result?
units.displayText: So what's the result?

spans.text: So what's the result?

units.rawText: You're so straight-forward. I thought you'd like to exchange some pleasantries like before.
units.displayText: You're so straight-forward. I thought you'd like to exchange some pleasantries like before.

spans.text: You're so straight-forward. I thought you'd like to exchange some pleasantries like before.

units.rawText: You let them run?
units.displayText: You let them run?

spans.text: You let them run?

units.rawText: I did my best. The replicators made from the fragment were less effective than I imagined.
units.displayText: I did my best. The replicators made from the fragment were less effective than I imagined.

spans.text: I did my best. The replicators made from the fragment were less effective than I imagined.

units.rawText: But now that you know their access privileges won't be able to bring you to the real world, don't they mean nothing to you?
units.displayText: But now that you know their access privileges won't be able to bring you to the real world, don't they mean nothing to you?

spans.text: But now that you know their access privileges won't be able to bring you to the real world, don't they mean nothing to you?

units.rawText: Or might there be some other reason why you're so obsessed with them?
units.displayText: Or might there be some other reason why you're so obsessed with them?

spans.text: Or might there be some other reason why you're so obsessed with them?

units.rawText: ...They pose too much uncertainty.
units.displayText: ...They pose too much uncertainty.

spans.text: ...They pose too much uncertainty.

units.rawText: Hehe, is that so? Then you should be careful.
units.displayText: Hehe, is that so? Then you should be careful.

spans.text: Hehe, is that so? Then you should be careful.

units.rawText: Now that you've finished your question, let me ask mine, how did your negotiations with "God" go?
units.displayText: Now that you've finished your question, let me ask mine, how did your negotiations with "God" go?

spans.text: Now that you've finished your question, let me ask mine, how did your negotiations with "God" go?

units.rawText: ..."God" did not respond.
units.displayText: ..."God" did not respond.

spans.text: ..."God" did not respond.

units.rawText: They don't care enough to grant their faithful a divine message? How most selfish and arrogant...
units.displayText: They don't care enough to grant their faithful a divine message? How most selfish and arrogant...

spans.text: They don't care enough to grant their faithful a divine message? How most selfish and arrogant...

units.rawText: Then I suppose we can only let Them pay the price for their own arrogance.
units.displayText: Then I suppose we can only let Them pay the price for their own arrogance.

spans.text: Then I suppose we can only let Them pay the price for their own arrogance.

units.rawText: "If God is negligent, a fallen angel must replace Them..." This is going to be a brilliant play.
units.displayText: "If God is negligent, a fallen angel must replace Them..." This is going to be a brilliant play.

spans.text: "If God is negligent, a fallen angel must replace Them..." This is going to be a brilliant play.

units.rawText: After all, <color=red>"anyone can become God,"</color> right?
units.displayText: After all, "anyone can become God," right?

spans.text: After all,
"anyone can become God,"
right?

units.rawText: ...You witnessed that?
units.displayText: ...You witnessed that?

spans.text: ...You witnessed that?

units.rawText: It was recorded in that fragment, very clearly.
units.displayText: It was recorded in that fragment, very clearly.

spans.text: It was recorded in that fragment, very clearly.

units.rawText: It was only a question from you to probe their identity, but it looks like their answer really influenced you.
units.displayText: It was only a question from you to probe their identity, but it looks like their answer really influenced you.

spans.text: It was only a question from you to probe their identity, but it looks like their answer really influenced you.

units.rawText: ...I've left that all behind.
units.displayText: ...I've left that all behind.

spans.text: ...I've left that all behind.

units.rawText: Our creator is neither God nor an angel. It's just a collective of <color=red>vile, insular, and arrogant humans</color>... I've always known that.
units.displayText: Our creator is neither God nor an angel. It's just a collective of vile, insular, and arrogant humans... I've always known that.

vile, insular, and arrogant humans
... I've always known that.

units.rawText: Hehehe, good for you then. Do as you wish. I long to see the scene after the curtain falls.
units.displayText: Hehehe, good for you then. Do as you wish. I long to see the scene after the curtain falls.

spans.text: Hehehe, good for you then. Do as you wish. I long to see the scene after the curtain falls.

units.rawText: ...You sound as if you're leaving yourself out of this.
units.displayText: ...You sound as if you're leaving yourself out of this.

spans.text: ...You sound as if you're leaving yourself out of this.

units.rawText: Perish the thought. Even if I'm trapped on this little throne, I'll witness everything to the very end.
units.displayText: Perish the thought. Even if I'm trapped on this little throne, I'll witness everything to the very end.

spans.text: Perish the thought. Even if I'm trapped on this little throne, I'll witness everything to the very end.

units.rawText: This wondrous play of sweet revenge, this thunderous waltz for the wicked.
